title: Wrong page cite for the Operate category
cues: Settings/Sources job with queue cite, catalog with datagrid cite, or chart atom as page lead — category truth broken
ban: Page cite must match category truth; chart atoms never lead Operate triage.
remediation: Rebind cite (rebind-cite op); fix packet --category; re-run cite + measure; write cite-ban only after a real prove fail with doctorBiteOk.
examples: SLED Sources: data-cite=shadcn-queue on a settings/directory job
Chart atom selected as primary page cite for a queue triage brief
